leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a custom Angular hook that fetches data from an API
Initialize state variables to manage loading, error, and data responses
Configure the hook to accept dynamic URL parameters for flexible API calls
Implement error handling to manage failed HTTP requests gracefully
Bind the hook's return values to component templates for dynamic rendering
Integrate the custom hook into multiple components to demonstrate reusability
Manipulate the hook's behavior by passing different configuration options
